name: workloop-plugin
description: Add deterministic gates, work-item projections, and optional Contract checks to the Workloop method.

interface.shortDescription: Deterministic gates for lightweight Workloop artifacts.
interface.longDescription: Checks Workloop state changes, acceptance coverage, blocking assumptions, shared Contracts, Evidence references, independent review structure, and active work-item scope without recreating the old governance model.
defaultPrompt: Project the current Workloop work item.
